Sentence (English): After using the GE Dishwasher Model GDT535PYV6FS for some time, I have mixed feelings about its performance and design.
Comments (English): [ Cleans Extremely Well - I dislike the rack design ] || ---------------- || After using the GE Dishwasher Model GDT535PYV6FS for some time, I have mixed feelings about its performance and design. On the positive side, the dishwasher does an excellent job cleaning dishes, leaving them spotless after every cycle. Although it's rated with a standard noise level, I found it to be surprisingly quiet while running, which is great for open-concept spaces or late-night use. I appreciate the thoughtful features like the amber light on the door panel, which indicates when the machine is running a cycle, and turns white once washing and drying are complete. This visual cue is helpful for knowing at a glance when the dishes are done. Another nice touch is the tilted glass and cup holder, which ensures water drains off the bottom, helping prevent water spots. Features I Dislike. • The biggest drawback for me is the tilted bottoms of both the upper and lower racks. While the manual includes photos of different loading options, I still struggle to fit plates and bowls due to this design. Loading dishes was much easier with my older GE dishwasher. • The rinse aid dispenser is another area of frustration. It uses a domed transparent bubble cap that turns opaque when full and is clear when empty or low. This design makes it difficult to judge how much rinse aid remains. My previous model had a floating bar that clearly showed levels from full to empty, which was much more intuitive. • The included owner's manual was only two pages and lacked any real instructions for operating the dishwasher. I had to go online to the GE website and download a 14-page PDF manual to figure out the basics. I worry that some new customers might not think to do this and could be left without essential information. The “getting started” section of the manual is also confusing. It lists 16 different options that may or may not apply to your specific model. I had to go through and check off the ones relevant to my dishwasher, which turned out to be a frustrating and time-consuming process. Overall, while the GE GDT535PYV6FS performs well in terms of cleaning dishes, the process of loading the racks and navigating the controls takes some getting used to. If you value quiet operation and effective cleaning, this model delivers, but be prepared for a learning curve when it comes to loading dishes and using the various features.

It has a pocket handle with the control panel on the top of the door. It runs quiet and the only time we can hear it is when it is emptying out into the sink drain and when it plays a nice little song for a split second when its ready to go. There are various wash cycles that can be chosen based upon how full the washer is and how dirty the dishes are. We usually use the auto cycle that senses the level of cleaning needed and dishes come out immaculate. When choosing your wash cycle the display shows the time to complete. The washer is easy to fill and empty and it holds a great amount on three racks. The top utensil rack hold a lot and the basket utensil in the bottom rack has a handle and is removable. The center rack can easily be raised and lowered to accommodate the size of your bowls and pans. This is very nice feature when you are washing large pots and pans. An led light lets you know when the washing cycle is complete. This dishwasher also does a very good job drying everything. Wa are very happy with this washer.

Sentence (English): My kitchen doesn't allow for 12-person seating, so I purchased this dishwasher because I thought it would be more than enough for a family of 2-3.
Comments (English): [ Hot air drying isn't perfect. ] || ---------------- || My kitchen doesn't allow for 12-person seating, so I purchased this dishwasher because I thought it would be more than enough for a family of 2-3. It's been about 4 days since installation. The internal structure is two-tiered, and the top is easily removable. Deep pots can be washed after removing the top, and it can accommodate a fairly generous amount of dishes. It can even accommodate small frying pans (19-24cm in diameter), pots, and royal pans. Noise levels may vary, but it's a bit noisy and noisy for late-night use. The installer said that installing a keyboard or mouse pad from Daiso would reduce the noise and vibration by about half. The normal mode takes a long time, about 138 minutes, but it washes thoroughly. The low and high-temperature modes are relatively fast, about 85 minutes. All modes are very thorough. When loading multiple dishes, be sure to stack them carefully so they don't get caught in the central spray. This way, all dishes are thoroughly cleaned. I like that the sprayer checks the dishes after loading. It's very clean and I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power. However, one thing I'm disappointed about is that the water doesn't completely dry when using the hot air dryer. Since it's a 6-person dishwasher, I can't adjust the hot air drying time from the default setting, so there's still quite a bit of water left. However, thanks to the automatic door opening function, it's not a major inconvenience. I used to get stressed about washing dishes, but this one thing has relieved my stress. I used to hate doing dishes so I kept putting them off, and the dishes would fill up the sink. Now that I have the dishwasher installed, I can just run it right after eating, which is a plus. It also eliminates arguments between spouses over washing dishes, which is great. If you don't like washing dishes, I recommend purchasing one, even if it's a 6-person dishwasher. Even if you do it twice or three times a day, it's much better than nothing.

After much deliberation, I finally bought a dishwasher, and I'm so happy I'm wondering why I waited so long to buy one. The features I'm most pleased with are: 1. The door automatically opens after washing, allowing it to dry naturally, so there are virtually no water stains and it's ready to be stored away. It also helps that plastic dishes don't get damp. 3. Quiet design. It's quiet even at night, so I can use it without any problems even after putting the baby to bed. 4. More storage capacity than I expected. It's more than enough for a family of three, and even pots and pans fit in without a problem if you position them at the right angle. Tip: Pre-wash with water only! Just rinse off any grease and put them back in. Baby dishes = Top, regular dishes = Bottom. Considering the location of the hot water spray, this arrangement is the cleanest. Use slightly less detergent than the standard amount. If you use too much, it leaves water marks. Between half and the standard amount is just right. I'm very satisfied! Because the dishwashing time is reduced, the stress of childcare has been reduced. Not only the function, but the beige color and design are very neat and pretty... I was debating between the Samsung and the Samsung, but my choice was right!

Sentence (English): We purchased the GE dishwasher after our Frigidaire motor stopped.
Comments (English): [ Horrible Install Instructions, Does not Dry Well. ] || ---------------- || We purchased the GE dishwasher after our Frigidaire motor stopped. For a $1000 dishwasher we were dissapointed and was expecting better quality. HORRIBLE INSTRUCTIONS. Several of the install sections and pictorials did not match this dishwasher and were very confusing to follow. The pictorials are simple line art, not pictures, that made it difficult to understand.BENT FEET: The adjustable feet were bent and because of that they could not screwed in and out to adjust the height of the machine. NO FEET PAD PROTECTION: The adjustable feet have no pads, they are just smooth metal against the floor. So we had to be extra careful to lay tarps to protect the wood floor from scratches when slide the dishwasher in and out.HOLES NOT THREADED: One would think that for a $1000 machine they would have spent the $0.001 effort to thread the holes to make installation of the kick panel easier. They provide self tapping screws and you have to lay on your side and using a socket driver have to press inordinately hard to self tap the holes. Very awkward.SHALLOW TOP SHELF: The top shelf is all but useless. Its so shallow that even small bowls will not fit. I suppose its only good for large utensils like spatulas.HAD WATER IN IT: When we tilted the machine for install access, water ran out over our floor. I guess water they forgot to drain after testing. Or again maybe it saved the $0.001.-- CLEANING NOT SO GOOD: Bowls we placed in the top shelf did not clean very well and there was residue left in them. We need to make sure the spray bar under the shelf can turn freely and not obstructed by anything under it.-- DRYING NOT SO GOOD: There was a lot of water left especially on glasses or tumblers that had a concave bottom.-- ADJUSTABLE SHELF IS HANDY: We found the adjustable shelf was handy to move the shelf higher out of the way of items in the lower shelf. -- REASONABLY QUIET: rated at 45db its noiser that or previous Fridgidaire which had a 50db rating but it still quiet enough for us.-- FOOD GRINDER? The specs say it has a food grinder but the filter has a fine mesh screen. We explicitly did not want a screen as it collects food and starts smelling. We may remove the screen and see how it does or if it really has a grinder.

Sentence (English): *This is review is about Costco's installation, NOT the Bosch dishwasher itself.
Comments (English): [ Don't buy this from Costco ] || ---------------- || *This is review is about Costco's installation, NOT the Bosch dishwasher itself. Buyer beware when purchasing from Costco, you may not get your appliance.* We previously had a Bosch dishwasher years ago and loved it and knew that's what we'd get next time we needed one. We're a family of 6 and our old Whirlpool (that came with the house) broke so we shopped around a lot and Costco had the fastest installation time out of everyone. We purchased it from Costco online with the impression that we'd have it installed within a few days. The day before installation, I got a text confirmation that the 3rd party installation company would be there during the correct timeframe. Exactly 1 hour later, I got a call from a number 2,000 miles away stating they had high volume so they couldn't install for another 12 days. TWELVE DAYS without a dishwasher for a family of 6. Not to mention the time to take off work to be available on multiple different days. I asked them to put me on the list to deliver/install early but they never called. The day before that new installation date, I again got a text confirmation of our timeframe. But A FEW HOURS LATER AGAIN, they called and said they had to cancel the installation, they couldn't make it. Now the new date is a week later. I don't know who these people are that Costco uses but if you buy from Costco, just know you won't get your dishwasher when they say you will. We've been members for 14 years and never had an issue but this is unacceptable and beyond frustrating. If we had been told there was an issue or high volume and to expect delays that would be one thing, I would have shopped elsewhere. But we had a set date when we purchased, and expected that to be followed. But I don't think they care about following the delivery date. Now we are without a dishwasher for 3+ weeks and I have zero faith that it will actually arrive and be installed. I'm very close to cancelling the order altogether and shopping somewhere else so we can just have a working dishwasher in the house. I'm not a complainer and I've never written a review like this, but with 2 full-time working parents with kids in multiple sports, we need working appliances to keep our house running smoothly. I hope Costco does the right thing and cuts ties with this awful 3rd party installation company because if not, they will be losing business left and right. I really do hope the dishwasher itself is worth it because right now, it doesn't seem to be.

Buyer beware when purchasing from Costco, you may not get your appliance.* We previously had a Bosch dishwasher years ago and loved it and knew that's what we'd get next time we needed one. We're a family of 6 and our old Whirlpool (that came with the house) broke so we shopped around a lot and Costco had the fastest installation time out of everyone. We purchased it from Costco online with the impression that we'd have it installed within a few days. The day before installation, I got a text confirmation that the 3rd party installation company would be there during the correct timeframe. Exactly 1 hour later, I got a call from a number 2,000 miles away stating they had high volume so they couldn't install for another 12 days. TWELVE DAYS without a dishwasher for a family of 6. Not to mention the time to take off work to be available on multiple different days. I asked them to put me on the list to deliver/install early but they never called. The day before that new installation date, I again got a text confirmation of our timeframe. But A FEW HOURS LATER AGAIN, they called and said they had to cancel the installation, they couldn't make it. Now the new date is a week later. I don't know who these people are that Costco uses but if you buy from Costco, just know you won't get your dishwasher when they say you will. We've been members for 14 years and never had an issue but this is unacceptable and beyond frustrating. If we had been told there was an issue or high volume and to expect delays that would be one thing, I would have shopped elsewhere. But we had a set date when we purchased, and expected that to be followed. But I don't think they care about following the delivery date. Now we are without a dishwasher for 3+ weeks and I have zero faith that it will actually arrive and be installed. I'm very close to cancelling the order altogether and shopping somewhere else so we can just have a working dishwasher in the house. I'm not a complainer and I've never written a review like this, but with 2 full-time working parents with kids in multiple sports, we need working appliances to keep our house running smoothly. I hope Costco does the right thing and cuts ties with this awful 3rd party installation company because if not, they will be losing business left and right. Sentence (English): From a build and capacity perspective, this dishwasher performs strongly.
Comments (English): [ Product Review – Bosch Series 6 Freestanding Dishw ] || ---------------- || From a build and capacity perspective, this dishwasher performs strongly. The design is clean and modern, the internal layout is spacious, and it comfortably handles a full household load without feeling cramped. In terms of physical quality and wash performance, it aligns with what one would reasonably expect from Bosch at this price point. However, the digital experience significantly undermines the overall value proposition. Pairing the appliance with the mobile app is unnecessarily difficult, and once connected, several core functions either do not work as expected or are poorly implemented. Basic tasks—such as setting the clock or adjusting the date—cannot be done easily via the app, which is counter-intuitive for a “smart” appliance. The interface lacks clarity, feels over-engineered, and offers little transparency to the user. Additionally, the standard warranty coverage is surprisingly limited for a premium brand. Extending the warranty required an extra payment, which feels more like a forced upsell than a value-add. Bottom line: Well-built, attractive, and roomy hardware, but let down by an overly complex app ecosystem and weak default warranty coverage. If smart features and long-term assurance matter to you, these limitations should be factored into the purchase decision.

Sentence (English): I've never disliked a dishwasher as much as this one.
Comments (English): [ Not At All Worth the Price ] || ---------------- || I've never disliked a dishwasher as much as this one. This dishwasher is not worth the cost at all, even with Black Friday sales. I would give this zero stars if possible based on the cost vs the entire experience with this dishwasher over the past few days. Save your money and skip this one. First, it was delivered on a Friday. Packaging was fine, no issues there and the plan was to install the next day on Saturday. It's a Bosch, so as long as Home Depot didn't destroy it during delivery, all should be good or so I thought. After opening the door of the dishwasher on Saturday, I found that both my bottom and middle rack were covered top and bottom in black spots (see pictures), which smelled and felt like grease. So zero stars for Bosch quality control.I wasn't happy about it, but I assumed a wash cycle would rinse everything off. The install was pretty standard, other than the cheap paper thin clips used to mount the dishwasher. Once the dishwasher was installed, I ran a quick cycle with just water. Grease was still there. Then I ran a normal cycle with soap and nothing else in it. Grease still there. Then a cycle with a dishwasher cleaner on the hottest temperature setting. Grease still there. Then a fourth cycle with just soap again on the hottest temperature, and again, no luck. The only way to get the grease off was to scrub and wipe down both racks and clean the same grease out of the filter. Given the price of this dishwasher, that is completely unacceptable.Also, given how long the cycles take and the fact that I can't dedicate every minute of my life to fixing my brand new expensive dishwasher, we were now out of Home Depot's garbage 48 hour return window. Now I'm stuck with this thing.As far as use - the wifi and HomeConnect are unnecessary and "features" I will never use. I knew this going in, but overlooked those "features" for the rest of the good things said about this dishwasher. However, the dishwasher has a machine cleaning cycle that may have been helpful with the grease, but it is only accessible through HomeConnect. Seriously? So now I have to play around with an app if I want to run the cleaning cycle. What a poor design. Trying to get HomeConnect to actually connect and work has been another source of frustration, but to be fair, I didn't give it much of a chance since I wanted to to focus on getting dishes clean rather than screwing around with my phone and yet another app. It would be way easier to just use the control panel sitting right in front of me if it actually had the option to run all of the cycles. The capacity of the dishwasher was another issue. It is far less than the older dishwasher this replaces. If your dishes have a lip, it is quite possible they won't fit correctly in this dishwasher. Bowls are also a challenge, and the middle rack doesn't hold as many glasses / cups as my previous dishwasher due to the rack design the plastic wine glass holders.All in all, I made a huge mistake in buying this dishwasher. If you're considering this one at all, make sure you see it in person and really consider if the rack setup will work for you. Definitely don't buy it from Home Depot unless you plan on opening it immediately and inspecting every single part of it both inside and out since Bosch quality control seems pretty incompetent.

Sentence (English): We purchased the GE dishwasher after our Frigidaire motor stopped.
Comments (English): [ Horrible Install Instructions, Does not Dry Well. ] || ---------------- || We purchased the GE dishwasher after our Frigidaire motor stopped. For a $1000 dishwasher we were dissapointed and was expecting better quality. HORRIBLE INSTRUCTIONS. Several of the install sections and pictorials did not match this dishwasher and were very confusing to follow. The pictorials are simple line art, not pictures, that made it difficult to understand. BENT FEET: The adjustable feet were bent and because of that they could not screwed in and out to adjust the height of the machine. NO FEET PAD PROTECTION: The adjustable feet have no pads, they are just smooth metal against the floor. So we had to be extra careful to lay tarps to protect the wood floor from scratches when slide the dishwasher in and out. HOLES NOT THREADED: One would think that for a $1000 machine they would have spent the $0.001 effort to thread the holes to make installation of the kick panel easier. They provide self tapping screws and you have to lay on your side and using a socket driver have to press inordinately hard to self tap the holes. Very awkward. SHALLOW TOP SHELF: The top shelf is all but useless. Its so shallow that even small bowls will not fit. I suppose its only good for large utensils like spatulas. HAD WATER IN IT: When we tilted the machine for install access, water ran out over our floor. I guess water they forgot to drain after testing. Or again maybe it saved the $0.001. -- CLEANING NOT SO GOOD: Bowls we placed in the top shelf did not clean very well and there was residue left in them. We need to make sure the spray bar under the shelf can turn freely and not obstructed by anything under it. -- DRYING NOT SO GOOD: There was a lot of water left especially on glasses or tumblers that had a concave bottom. -- ADJUSTABLE SHELF IS HANDY: We found the adjustable shelf was handy to move the shelf higher out of the way of items in the lower shelf. -- REASONABLY QUIET: rated at 45db its noiser that or previous Fridgidaire which had a 50db rating but it still quiet enough for us. -- FOOD GRINDER? The specs say it has a food grinder but the filter has a fine mesh screen. We explicitly did not want a screen as it collects food and starts smelling. We may remove the screen and see how it does or if it really has a grinder.

Sentence (English): We've been using the Bosch SMS4HVI02E for a while now, and honestly, we're very happy with our purchase.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We've been using the Bosch SMS4HVI02E for a while now, and honestly, we're very happy with our purchase. The upper cutlery drawer has been especially practical and helps us make better use of the interior. As for the washing, it leaves everything really clean, even with dried-on food. We usually use the 1-hour program, and the results are excellent without needing to rinse beforehand. The drying is also good, which isn't always the case with other dishwashers, especially with plastic items. Comments (Original): [ Buen lavavajillas ] || ---------------- || Llevamos un tiempo usando el Bosch SMS4HVI02E y, sinceramente, estamos muy contentos con la compra. Sentence (English): The second delivery went well.
Comments (English): The second delivery went well. The first delivery the installer said he couldn't install the dishwasher and gave some weird excuse that the dishwasher was for commercial use. Because It wasn't clear whether installlng an outlet or the plumbing was a problem, I had an outlet installed. Then if on the subsequent delivery if the person couldn't/wouldn't install it I was prepared to have him leave the dishwasher and would have my plumber install it. But with the 2nd install all went great --the crew was friendly and helpful. I love the dishwasher . it is quiet and the dishes are CLEAN. I am trying to figure out how to load dishes. My old dishwasher had clips to hold wine glasses, this doesn't have any particular support. Not sure the little shelf for knives is worth it because I still need to put utensils somewhere. And I can only put shorter items under that 'knife holder". I have had it about a month. I also needed the ada compliant model because of the size of the area where it would be installed. Was very difficult to search on the height of the machine -- so I discovered ada compliant because it is shorter than "regular" dishwashers. Once installed we found that the depth was a little more than the space available (we jury rigged a. cabinet to install the dishwasher years ago). So we are going to carve out more space. sometime. so far highly recommend. Also suggest asking your town officials whether the water is soft. my town engineer clearly stated it was soft and we don't need product to make the water softer. Apparently that is the rage to find yet something else to sell people. The numbers for hard/soft water are way off in the description.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS DISHWASHER AND FROM GE! If GE wants to make this right, contact me and offer me a credit to my original reseller.

Sentence (English): Why is it tough?
Comments (English): [ This is a tough one ] || ---------------- || Why is it tough? I am comparing it to an older dishwasher that although had a fair number of replacement control boards needed over time, it did a good job cleaning and drying the dishes. We've had this one about a month at this point. Apparently newer dishwashers (or at least most? ) don't come with heating elements that will help with drying. I was surprised how wet everything still is when it's done. Rinse aid has helped with this but it's annoying I have to buy another product if I want my dishes anywhere close to being as dry as they were with my old dishwasher. Next is cleaning. Most things have come out pretty good but we have had some silverware that still has crusties on them so we end up hand washing them. I was not expecting that to be an issue. Next is the water hookup at the bottom back of the machine. What a terrible spot for it! Once you hook this up and slide it into place, there is no way to make sure it's not leaking at the hookup. To compare, my old machine had the hookup on the bottom front where I could still see it once installed as well as tighten it more if needed. I know Bosch dishwashers are generally highly rated so at this point, my only hope is that it at least keeps running without failure. I don't think I would buy this model again though. Might still go with Bosch but at least something that is supposed to dry better.

In the end though, this is not a big deal for me.

Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. Actually, I had a lot of doubts about whether I should get one. I was debating about getting a robot vacuum cleaner, but since we used to order delivery only three or four times a day—if at all—we cook at home a lot now! Besides the dishwashing, my husband insisted that we buy a dishwasher to make things easier, even if we only use it once a day, so I decided to purchase one. For delivery, the technician called the day before my requested date and arrived at the promised time. Since we live in an older apartment building, we just listened to the explanation, signed the paperwork, and had it installed. Because the wiring for the dishwasher was already prepared separately, the installation was done immediately. The floor wasn't quite flat, so they put in a lot of effort to level it. I'm not using any other modes right now, just the basic mode, but even using the all-in-one detergent, there is no water stain, and the cleaning is incredibly thorough. I am very satisfied. We use it about once a day; if we run it in the evening before going to sleep, the dishes are perfectly dry when we wake up in the morning. I plan to try using it in various ways in the future, but so far, I am so satisfied that I think I made a great purchase. It matches the same color as my refrigerator, so it blends well with my home, and I love it. One month of use review! I make sure to run it once or twice a day, and checking the app, the electricity usage isn't high. Since it cleans thoroughly, it speeds up my kitchen cleanup time, which is great. Once you get the hang of putting dishes in, it becomes really convenient, and I understand why people call them "Dishwasher Lady." I still don't put in things that seem a bit ambiguous; I don't put in glass lids for side dishes, plastic lids (even if they are allowed), or stainless steel lids. I only put in dishes and containers. I like Samsung appliances, but my refrigerator and dishwasher are LG, and after using this one, I'm even more satisfied, so I'm becoming very interested in LG appliances! There are also a lot of new songs added for the dishwasher's closing time, so it's fun to choose from. You can check whether the dishwasher is on or off, as well as the remaining time, all through the app. I already had the app installed because of my refrigerator, but the technician explained and downloaded everything for me during installation, so feel free to use it comfortably :). I heard that error codes sometimes pop up, and we had a hard time with one this time as well. It was exactly one month into use, and a message kept saying there was a drainage issue. So I searched online and found that you need to dry the inside completely, so I spent two or three days at home trying everything, including using a hair dryer, but my husband was so anxious that he told me to just call for service. He said there wouldn't be any service fees and told me not to be foolish, so I applied for service right away. Everyone had written on blogs that it was difficult to get in touch when applying for service, but applying was actually very easy. I was able to apply directly without connecting to a representative, and a technician came the very next day. They said there was a drainage problem, but it turned out the error was caused by a faulty part. It turned out this wasn't a problem I could fix on my own. The technician said they didn't have the part right now but would order it and fix it within two days, but since the weekend was included, it turned out to be about four days. Thankfully, although they said they could come after the weekend, they came on Friday evening and fixed it. So I tested it that evening, and it worked perfectly. I was very satisfied with LG, especially regarding their service. If an error pops up, I highly recommend applying for the service without hesitation! 2-Month Review :). I honestly don't know what I would have done without this. Since it's vacation, I cook three meals a day. I cook rice in the morning, pre-wash it right away, put it in, and just wash simple cups and cutlery. Then I gather everything up and run it once in the evening, and it's so incredibly convenient. Even organizing the dishes in the morning is fun when I see them sparkling clean. I start the dishwasher in the evening, wrap up the kitchen, and organize the dishes first thing in the morning before cooking rice; it makes me so happy. The fun of stacking them neatly, the fun of taking out the sparkling dishes, and even the happiness of not having to do the dishes. It is truly the number one dishwasher lady. Bought with my own money. This is a review updated after using it. My satisfaction has gone up even more. If my review was helpful, please press the "Helpful" button.

I was debating about getting a robot vacuum cleaner, but since we used to order delivery only three or four times a day—if at all—we cook at home a lot now! Besides the dishwashing, my husband insisted that we buy a dishwasher to make things easier, even if we only use it once a day, so I decided to purchase one. For delivery, the technician called the day before my requested date and arrived at the promised time. Since we live in an older apartment building, we just listened to the explanation, signed the paperwork, and had it installed. Because the wiring for the dishwasher was already prepared separately, the installation was done immediately. The floor wasn't quite flat, so they put in a lot of effort to level it. I'm not using any other modes right now, just the basic mode, but even using the all-in-one detergent, there is no water stain, and the cleaning is incredibly thorough. I am very satisfied. We use it about once a day; if we run it in the evening before going to sleep, the dishes are perfectly dry when we wake up in the morning. I plan to try using it in various ways in the future, but so far, I am so satisfied that I think I made a great purchase. It matches the same color as my refrigerator, so it blends well with my home, and I love it. One month of use review! I make sure to run it once or twice a day, and checking the app, the electricity usage isn't high. Since it cleans thoroughly, it speeds up my kitchen cleanup time, which is great. Once you get the hang of putting dishes in, it becomes really convenient, and I understand why people call them "Dishwasher Lady." I still don't put in things that seem a bit ambiguous; I don't put in glass lids for side dishes, plastic lids (even if they are allowed), or stainless steel lids. I only put in dishes and containers. I like Samsung appliances, but my refrigerator and dishwasher are LG, and after using this one, I'm even more satisfied, so I'm becoming very interested in LG appliances! There are also a lot of new songs added for the dishwasher's closing time, so it's fun to choose from. You can check whether the dishwasher is on or off, as well as the remaining time, all through the app. I already had the app installed because of my refrigerator, but the technician explained and downloaded everything for me during installation, so feel free to use it comfortably :). I heard that error codes sometimes pop up, and we had a hard time with one this time as well. It was exactly one month into use, and a message kept saying there was a drainage issue. So I searched online and found that you need to dry the inside completely, so I spent two or three days at home trying everything, including using a hair dryer, but my husband was so anxious that he told me to just call for service. He said there wouldn't be any service fees and told me not to be foolish, so I applied for service right away. Everyone had written on blogs that it was difficult to get in touch when applying for service, but applying was actually very easy. I was able to apply directly without connecting to a representative, and a technician came the very next day. They said there was a drainage problem, but it turned out the error was caused by a faulty part. It turned out this wasn't a problem I could fix on my own. The technician said they didn't have the part right now but would order it and fix it within two days, but since the weekend was included, it turned out to be about four days. Thankfully, although they said they could come after the weekend, they came on Friday evening and fixed it. So I tested it that evening, and it worked perfectly. I was very satisfied with LG, especially regarding their service. If an error pops up, I highly recommend applying for the service without hesitation! 2-Month Review :). I honestly don't know what I would have done without this. Since it's vacation, I cook three meals a day. I cook rice in the morning, pre-wash it right away, put it in, and just wash simple cups and cutlery. Then I gather everything up and run it once in the evening, and it's so incredibly convenient. Even organizing the dishes in the morning is fun when I see them sparkling clean. I start the dishwasher in the evening, wrap up the kitchen, and organize the dishes first thing in the morning before cooking rice; it makes me so happy. The fun of stacking them neatly, the fun of taking out the sparkling dishes, and even the happiness of not having to do the dishes. It is truly the number one dishwasher lady. Bought with my own money. This is a review updated after using it. My satisfaction has gone up even more. If my review was helpful, please press the "Helpful" button.

Besides the dishwashing, my husband insisted that we buy a dishwasher to make things easier, even if we only use it once a day, so I decided to purchase one. For delivery, the technician called the day before my requested date and arrived at the promised time. Since we live in an older apartment building, we just listened to the explanation, signed the paperwork, and had it installed. Because the wiring for the dishwasher was already prepared separately, the installation was done immediately. The floor wasn't quite flat, so they put in a lot of effort to level it. I'm not using any other modes right now, just the basic mode, but even using the all-in-one detergent, there is no water stain, and the cleaning is incredibly thorough. I am very satisfied. We use it about once a day; if we run it in the evening before going to sleep, the dishes are perfectly dry when we wake up in the morning. I plan to try using it in various ways in the future, but so far, I am so satisfied that I think I made a great purchase. It matches the same color as my refrigerator, so it blends well with my home, and I love it. One month of use review! I make sure to run it once or twice a day, and checking the app, the electricity usage isn't high. Since it cleans thoroughly, it speeds up my kitchen cleanup time, which is great. Once you get the hang of putting dishes in, it becomes really convenient, and I understand why people call them "Dishwasher Lady." I still don't put in things that seem a bit ambiguous; I don't put in glass lids for side dishes, plastic lids (even if they are allowed), or stainless steel lids. I only put in dishes and containers. I like Samsung appliances, but my refrigerator and dishwasher are LG, and after using this one, I'm even more satisfied, so I'm becoming very interested in LG appliances! There are also a lot of new songs added for the dishwasher's closing time, so it's fun to choose from. You can check whether the dishwasher is on or off, as well as the remaining time, all through the app. I already had the app installed because of my refrigerator, but the technician explained and downloaded everything for me during installation, so feel free to use it comfortably :). I heard that error codes sometimes pop up, and we had a hard time with one this time as well. It was exactly one month into use, and a message kept saying there was a drainage issue. So I searched online and found that you need to dry the inside completely, so I spent two or three days at home trying everything, including using a hair dryer, but my husband was so anxious that he told me to just call for service. He said there wouldn't be any service fees and told me not to be foolish, so I applied for service right away. Everyone had written on blogs that it was difficult to get in touch when applying for service, but applying was actually very easy. I was able to apply directly without connecting to a representative, and a technician came the very next day. They said there was a drainage problem, but it turned out the error was caused by a faulty part. It turned out this wasn't a problem I could fix on my own. The technician said they didn't have the part right now but would order it and fix it within two days, but since the weekend was included, it turned out to be about four days. Thankfully, although they said they could come after the weekend, they came on Friday evening and fixed it. So I tested it that evening, and it worked perfectly. I was very satisfied with LG, especially regarding their service. If an error pops up, I highly recommend applying for the service without hesitation! 2-Month Review :). I honestly don't know what I would have done without this. Since it's vacation, I cook three meals a day. I cook rice in the morning, pre-wash it right away, put it in, and just wash simple cups and cutlery. Then I gather everything up and run it once in the evening, and it's so incredibly convenient. Even organizing the dishes in the morning is fun when I see them sparkling clean. I start the dishwasher in the evening, wrap up the kitchen, and organize the dishes first thing in the morning before cooking rice; it makes me so happy. The fun of stacking them neatly, the fun of taking out the sparkling dishes, and even the happiness of not having to do the dishes. It is truly the number one dishwasher lady. Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. Actually, I had a lot of doubts about whether I should get one. I was debating about getting a robot vacuum cleaner, but since we used to order delivery only three or four times a day—if at all—we cook at home a lot now! Besides the dishwashing, my husband insisted that we buy a dishwasher to make things easier, even if we only use it once a day, so I decided to purchase one. For delivery, the technician called the day before my requested date and arrived at the promised time. Since we live in an older apartment building, we just listened to the explanation, signed the paperwork, and had it installed. Because the wiring for the dishwasher was already prepared separately, the installation was done immediately. The floor wasn't quite flat, so they put in a lot of effort to level it. I'm not using any other modes right now, just the basic mode, but even using the all-in-one detergent, there is no water stain, and the cleaning is incredibly thorough. I am very satisfied. We use it about once a day; if we run it in the evening before going to sleep, the dishes are perfectly dry when we wake up in the morning. I plan to try using it in various ways in the future, but so far, I am so satisfied that I think I made a great purchase. It matches the same color as my refrigerator, so it blends well with my home, and I love it. One month of use review! I make sure to run it once or twice a day, and checking the app, the electricity usage isn't high. Since it cleans thoroughly, it speeds up my kitchen cleanup time, which is great. Once you get the hang of putting dishes in, it becomes really convenient, and I understand why people call them "Dishwasher Lady." I still don't put in things that seem a bit ambiguous; I don't put in glass lids for side dishes, plastic lids (even if they are allowed), or stainless steel lids. I only put in dishes and containers. I like Samsung appliances, but my refrigerator and dishwasher are LG, and after using this one, I'm even more satisfied, so I'm becoming very interested in LG appliances! There are also a lot of new songs added for the dishwasher's closing time, so it's fun to choose from. You can check whether the dishwasher is on or off, as well as the remaining time, all through the app. I already had the app installed because of my refrigerator, but the technician explained and downloaded everything for me during installation, so feel free to use it comfortably :). I heard that error codes sometimes pop up, and we had a hard time with one this time as well. It was exactly one month into use, and a message kept saying there was a drainage issue. So I searched online and found that you need to dry the inside completely, so I spent two or three days at home trying everything, including using a hair dryer, but my husband was so anxious that he told me to just call for service. He said there wouldn't be any service fees and told me not to be foolish, so I applied for service right away. Everyone had written on blogs that it was difficult to get in touch when applying for service, but applying was actually very easy. I was able to apply directly without connecting to a representative, and a technician came the very next day. They said there was a drainage problem, but it turned out the error was caused by a faulty part. It turned out this wasn't a problem I could fix on my own. The technician said they didn't have the part right now but would order it and fix it within two days, but since the weekend was included, it turned out to be about four days. Thankfully, although they said they could come after the weekend, they came on Friday evening and fixed it. So I tested it that evening, and it worked perfectly. I was very satisfied with LG, especially regarding their service. If an error pops up, I highly recommend applying for the service without hesitation! 2-Month Review :). I honestly don't know what I would have done without this. Since it's vacation, I cook three meals a day. I cook rice in the morning, pre-wash it right away, put it in, and just wash simple cups and cutlery. Then I gather everything up and run it once in the evening, and it's so incredibly convenient. Even organizing the dishes in the morning is fun when I see them sparkling clean. I start the dishwasher in the evening, wrap up the kitchen, and organize the dishes first thing in the morning before cooking rice; it makes me so happy. The fun of stacking them neatly, the fun of taking out the sparkling dishes, and even the happiness of not having to do the dishes. It is truly the number one dishwasher lady. Bought with my own money. This is a review updated after using it. My satisfaction has gone up even more. If my review was helpful, please press the "Helpful" button.

Sentence (English): In my previous home, I used a built-in Samsung dishwasher that came standard with apartments.
Comments (English): In my previous home, I used a built-in Samsung dishwasher that came standard with apartments. This time, I moved in, compared options carefully, and listened to an in-store explanation before purchasing. I'm very satisfied. I can use the downloaded features to customize the options I want, and the top shelf can be adjusted in height to accommodate ladles and other utensils. It was a bit awkward at first to place spoons and chopsticks side by side, but it's definitely cleaner, and after using it a couple of times, I've gotten the hang of it. The second shelf is fully adjustable, which is convenient, and I can even store small cups and wine glasses securely, showing how much thought went into its design. I also like the fact that the bottom shelf has places to place knives on the left and frying pans on the right. The detergent dispenser is also easier to use than the Samsung.
Comments (Original): 이전 집에는 아파트 기본으로 제공되는 빌트인 삼성 식기세척기를 썼었는데, 이번에 이사오면서 꼼꼼히 비교해보고 매장에서 설명도 듣고 구매했는데 대 만족 이요.다운로드한 기능으로 원하는 옵션으로 사용가능하고, 최상단도 왼쪽은 국자 등 넣을 수 있게 높이 조절되고, 숟가락 젓가락 나란히 눕혀 꽂는게 처음에는 불편했는데 확실히 더 깨끗하고 한두번 쓰니 요령생겨서 괜찮아요.두번째 선반은 전체 높낮이 조절되서 편리하고, 작은 컵, 와인잔 도 안정적으로 잘 적치해서 쓸 수 있어서 신경 많이써서 만들었구나 느껴지네요.맨하단에는 왼쪽에는 칼, 오른쪽에는 후라이팬 등 거치할 슨 있어서 좋아요.세제 넣는 통도 삼성보다 쓰기 편하네요.

Sentence (English): I recently purchased my first 12-seater dishwasher, and I'm so happy I should've done it sooner.
Comments (English): I recently purchased my first 12-seater dishwasher, and I'm so happy I should've done it sooner. I used to use a 6-seater, but I always felt like the capacity was lacking and the dishes just kept going on and on. But after upgrading to the LG Dios Objet Collection 12-seater built-in, my life has changed. First of all, I was happy to get it at a great price on Coupang, and I was extremely satisfied with the entire process, from delivery to installation. I was particularly impressed by the friendly and thorough installation. The installation process was smooth and the finishing touches were perfect, which made it a pleasure to use. The product itself is also LG, which I trust. The design is undeniably clean and stylish, enhancing the kitchen's overall look. The built-in design also offers significant space savings. The spacious interior allows for ample storage for large pots and pans, and the ease of organizing makes dishwashing much easier. The dishwashing power is also excellent, cleaning even greasy dishes thoroughly. It's also quiet, so I can run it at night without any problems. I'm so satisfied with this product that it's incomparable to the six-person model I used before, and I'm highly recommending it to my family. The price-to-performance ratio is truly impressive, and the installation service was perfect, making this purchase a complete success. I confidently recommend it to anyone considering Coupang. It's a product that makes me happy every time I use it!

LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher. Nature Manhattan Midnight (DUESMBL2E) review of my own purchase. One of the appliances I had the most difficulty deciding on while remodeling my house was the dishwasher. With so many brands and so many different features, I spent a lot of time comparing options, but the product I ultimately chose was the LG Electronics Dios Objet Collection 14-seater built-in dishwasher. Here, too, the model name and price can vary by 100,000-400,000 won depending on the hot air drying and True Steam functions. I was also considering the 12-seater and 14-seater models, but the only real difference between the two was the cutlery drawer at the top. Since the price difference wasn't that big, I decided on the 14-seater. Surprisingly, I've been using the cutlery drawer a lot! The color is Nature Manhattan Midnight, and it looks really luxurious in person. I can't help but talk about the design first. As expected from an objet collection, this dishwasher blends perfectly with the kitchen interior. It's understated yet solid and calming, so I always get asked where I got it at housewarming parties. The built-in design also makes the kitchen look much more organized, which is a huge plus. I deliberately chose a model that didn't include a hot air dryer. Personally, I find hot air dryers power-hungry and don't feel they're absolutely necessary. Instead, what I valued most was the TrueSteam feature, the core technology of LG dishwashers. It uses high-temperature, fine steam to thoroughly remove grease and ensures even baby dishes and glasses come out clean without residue. I was very satisfied with the dishwasher's clean finish, leaving no slippery residue. The capacity is enough for 14 people, so I can easily load not only my family's dishes but also pots and pans. The piled-up dishes after the housewarming are a breeze, and I often find myself wondering when I could have done it by hand. The internal layout is practical and well-designed, making dish arrangement easy, and with frequent use, I quickly became accustomed to it. The operation is also very simple. The intuitive button layout eliminates complex settings, so even my parents were able to use it right away after a quick explanation. It's also relatively quiet, so I didn't have to worry about running it at night. Another satisfying feature is that it's a top-rated energy-efficient appliance. After purchasing, I found out that I was eligible for a 10% rebate from the Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO), which made the perceived price even lower. This is a definite advantage these days, especially when electricity bills are so concerning. Overall, the LG Dios Objet Collection 14-Person Built-In Dishwasher offers a well-balanced product: design, cleaning power (True Steam), practical convenience, and energy efficiency. I highly recommend this home appliance to anyone looking for a dishwasher that offers only the essentials, rather than a plethora of fancy features.

I was very satisfied with the dishwasher's clean finish, leaving no slippery residue. The capacity is enough for 14 people, so I can easily load not only my family's dishes but also pots and pans. The intuitive button layout eliminates complex settings, so even my parents were able to use it right away after a quick explanation. Comments (English): [ Really Lovin' It! ] || ---------------- || I'm 73, with several types of arthritis and other physical issues. I pride myself on my clean and organized kitchen, and seeing the dirty dishes all the time was weighing on me. Now my husband yells at me (lovingly) if he finds me washing any dishes in the sink. This Bosch is really quiet, and does a great job. There are times, however, that I do need to dry the dishes as I take them out, but it's not a big deal. Now we go to bed each night knowing the kitchen is clean and ready for the new day!

It didn't make it six months before the display started to flicker and when I messaged GE about it, I never got a response. So now we have two GE Appliances one of them about three years old and the other one less than three weeks old and it has put a taste in our mouth that we will probably never purchase another GE appliance. It's a shame that somebody who's supposed to have such a good name. Can't make a product that's gonna do its job. I would almost rather have a $300 dishwasher that you could hear from the neighbors house that would wash dishes in an hour then this quiet thing that doesn't clean or dryer dishes. Personal suggestion… Stay away!

Sentence (English): I enjoy doing dishes.
Comments (English): I enjoy doing dishes. I bought this at my husband's recommendation because I've been experiencing shoulder and arm pain. I'm still not used to the dishwashing method, so it's taking a while. I think I need to practice a lot. It was bigger than I expected, and since we're a two-person household, I thought I'd only need to do it once a day. But I'm still doing it twice a day, once for lunch and once for dinner. I'm usually a stickler, so I used to think I'd just do the dishes during the pre-washing period, but now that I'm leaving it to civilization, I've been able to utilize my time more effectively. Once I get used to the dishwashing method, it'll definitely be more convenient. I'm only going to use the standard function, not the high-temperature sterilization, so I just put the water tank in and washed it. It washed well without any deformation. Since I use a solid detergent with an integrated rinse, I was worried about water stains, and it dries quickly. I highly recommend this.
Comments (Original): 설거지를 좋아하는 편인데어깨,팔통증이 생겨 남편의 권유로 구매하게 됐습니다.그릇배치가 아직은 익숙치 않아 시간이 오래 걸리는데연습을 많이 해봐야 될것 같아요.크기는 생각보다 컸고 2인가족이라 하루에 한번 돌리면 될거라 생각했는데아직은 점심, 저녁 두번 돌리고 있습니다.평소 고지식한 저는 애벌설거지 하는시간에 그냥 설거지를 하고 말지 하는 생각을 가지고 있었는데 확실히 문명에 맡기니 제 시간 활용이 늘어나고그릇배치만 익숙해지면 확실히 더 편해질것 같습니다.고온살균이 아닌 표준기능만 쓸거라 물통도 그냥 넣어서 세척했는데변형없이 세척 잘되는거 확인했습니다.린스일체형인 고체세제 써서 그런지 걱정했던 물자국도 안남고 건조 돼서 좋네요.강추합니다.

Sentence (English): I replaced a older Kenmore dishwasher with this Bosch, and I really wish I had just tried to get the Kenmore repaired.
Comments (English): [ Regret My Purchase ] || ---------------- || I replaced a older Kenmore dishwasher with this Bosch, and I really wish I had just tried to get the Kenmore repaired. Don't ask me how since it fits into the same size space in my kitchen, but the top rack is smaller than my old one. I need 4 rows for glasses, can't do that with Bosch unless you put glasses over prongs sticking up which I've read is not advisable. The bottom rack holds more plates than my old dishwasher, but the prongs are so close together it's hard to slide them into place. The silverware tray has one section that is missing a divider and all the silverware falls sideways too far in that section. Apparently you HAVE to use a rinse aid. My old machine did not require that and my glasses came out fine. I have not been using a rinse aid in the Bosch and my glasses are terribly spotty. Overall, my old Kenmore was far superior. I was told Bosch was one of the best brands for dishwashers, but not based on my experience.

Sentence (English): So happy I chose this dishwasher.
Comments (English): So happy I chose this dishwasher. It cleans perfectly without rinsing any dishes and everything comes out clean and dry. The 3rd rack is flexible and super handy for silverware. It's quiet except when it drains. The display is sleek and when it's running you can see the timer at the top of the panel that counts down. Installation was done by Homedepot but I would not do that again. First crew said they couldn't shut off the water and thus not install it. Upon inspection there was zero issues to turn it off so we rescheduled the install. Second crew confirmed there was no issue and installed it, but nothing was leveled properly, just connected and shoved into the opening. So get your own installer if you care about how well it is installed, or level it yourself. Other than that, the machine is great. I had a Bosch 500 before and this is even better, for less money.

Sentence (English): I replaced an aged (different brand) dishwasher with a Bosch 300 Series because it was time to do so.
Comments (English): [ Very plesantly surprised! ] || ---------------- || I replaced an aged (different brand) dishwasher with a Bosch 300 Series because it was time to do so. I first read reviews online and Consumer Report and watched YouTube videos, all of which led me to my decision based on my budget. What first amazed me was how good the Bosch looks and how quiet it is, comparatively speaking. Then I realized how well thought out the three pull out racks are, allowing me to wash nearly double the volume I was used to. Way to go Bosch! I really appreciate the “third” top rack. I've had this in place for just over a month and haven't yet tried out all of its features. But it does an absolutely splendid job of washing any and everything I placed in it. If I were allowed just one gripe, it wouldn't be with Bosch. I won't go into details here but I had an awful experience with Costco over their delivery, installation, billing and customer service. Enough said. Thank you Bosch for a truly wonderful product.

Sentence (English): I actually enjoy doing the dishes, but I started experiencing shoulder and arm pain, so I purchased this at my husband's recommendation.
Comments (English): I actually enjoy doing the dishes, but I started experiencing shoulder and arm pain, so I purchased this at my husband's recommendation. It takes a long time because I'm not yet used to arranging the dishes, so I think I need to practice a lot. The size was bigger than I expected, and since we are a family of two, I thought running it once a day would be enough, but I am currently running it twice a day, for lunch and dinner. Being a rather old-fashioned person, I used to think I might as well just do the dishes instead of spending time pre-washing, but letting modern technology handle it has definitely increased my time efficiency. I think it will become much more convenient once I get used to arranging the dishes. Since I only used the standard function and not the high-temperature sterilization, I just put the water tank in to wash it, and I confirmed that it cleaned well without any deformation. Perhaps because I used solid detergent with integrated rinse aid, it dries without leaving the water stains I was worried about, which is great. I highly recommend it. =================. This is a follow-up review written about ten days later. I am still clumsy enough to be able to do the dishes in the time I would have spent arranging and pre-washing, but... Since washing dishes requires less physical exertion and energy, I think I’ve gradually come to praise the dishwasher. It’s truly commendable. If you’re hesitating, just buy one. Leave it to modern technology and make things easier. Save your energy.

If you've got anything on the 3rd rack (very top) you might as well hand wash it before you put it in the dishwasher. It didn't make it six months before the display started to flicker and when I messaged GE about it, I never got a response. So now we have two GE Appliances one of them about three years old and the other one less than three weeks old and it has put a taste in our mouth that we will probably never purchase another GE appliance. It's a shame that somebody who's supposed to have such a good name. Can't make a product that's gonna do its job. I would almost rather have a $300 dishwasher that you could hear from the neighbors house that would wash dishes in an hour then this quiet thing that doesn't clean or dryer dishes. Personal suggestion… Stay away!

Sentence (English): We've been using this wonderful machine for almost a month.
Comments (English): [ You can't beat the cleaning! ] || ---------------- || We've been using this wonderful machine for almost a month. It's handled all our pre-Thanksgiving baking and of course Thanksgiving dinner beautifully. With our old machine we always scrapped, rinsed, and very often took a brush to even the simplest dishes - we even had to wipe butter knives. With this machine I continued to rinse most things, but always left a "test item or two to see if they'd be clean - I now know that even though we only run when we have a full load, we don't have to clean anything beforehand. I do make sure to scrape or wipe with a paper towel if there are larger particles, so the filter stays clean, but everything comes out sparkling! The pop-open feature and the lit clean indicator is handy too. The only negative is that I can't put as many bowls (especially slightly larger ones) without losing space for pots and pans so I may run slightly more loads - but that's worth it for the fantastic cleaning it does!

Sentence (English): So far I love this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ So far so good! ] || ---------------- || So far I love this dishwasher. My dishes get clean every time and I haven't experienced any nauseating smells coming from it. My previous dishwasher had issues getting all of the water out of it and if the dishes sat in it for any amount of time after the cycle was finished it would start to stink. The BlastZone Bottle Wash is neat because if you have bottles that need that extra attention you can put them right over a water jet. I use them for glasses that need that extra layer of washing. Although the installation team left much to be desired, the dishwasher fit right in and looks great. I like how the controls are on the top and don't take away from the sleek look of the face. Also, the center rack is adjustable up or down so you can put larger items in the bottom rack if necessary. There is a light at the bottom of the dishwasher that pulses while a cycle is running and stays solid when the cycle is finished. Overall, we have been pleased but surprised at how much louder it is in comparison to our last Bosch.

Sentence (English): Beware the CrystalDry “Feature” and Bosch's Refusal to Stand Behind It I purchased this $1,400+ Bosch 800 Series dishwasher in 2022 specifically for its vaunted CrystalDry technology that promised “the ultimate dry – even on plastics.”
Comments (English): [ Buyer Beware ] || ---------------- || Beware the CrystalDry “Feature” and Bosch's Refusal to Stand Behind It I purchased this $1,400+ Bosch 800 Series dishwasher in 2022 specifically for its vaunted CrystalDry technology that promised “the ultimate dry – even on plastics.” Three years of light-to-moderate use later, the machine began throwing an E07 error code. The flat plastic spray arm water supply tube (part 00628334 / 11018097) had multiple cracks and a hole exactly where it is blasted by hot steam from the zeolite drying system. The plastic literally became brittle and shattered under the repeated heat cycles that Bosch itself engineered into the machine. This is not isolated bad luck; it is an extremely well-documented design flaw across the entire CrystalDry lineup. Bosch quietly fixed the problem in later production runs by adding a molded heat shield around the tube, yet they refuse to acknowledge the earlier versions were defective. I contacted Bosch Customer Care with photos and a polite explanation of the known issue. Their response? ” NO RESPONSE. No goodwill part, no discounted replacement. For a company that markets “German engineering” and “lifetime stainless tub” warranties, refusing to address an obvious material incompatibility between their own drying system and a critical $40 plastic tube is indefensible. The dishwasher now sits unusable while I shop for a new dishwasher, and I will never purchase anything Bosch going forward. Save yourself the headache: if you want CrystalDry-level drying without the self-destructing plumbing, look at Miele or even KitchenAid's comparable models. Bosch's premium price does not buy premium support when their design flaws surface. Extremely disappointed.

Sentence (English): We love our Bosch 800 Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Wooowza ] || ---------------- || We love our Bosch 800 Dishwasher. It has solved problems we didn't even know we had. Like, wet plastics and object tetris. Since there isn't an exposed heating element we can put plastics anywhere and with the crystal drying the plastic plates and utensils for the kids are always dry now. The adjustable middle rack has been very useful in helping fit everything without having to rearrange a bunch of dishes to make it fit. The best overall feature is the silence, almost everytime we have to silence everything in the house to be sure that we hear it running, although I could just check the app and or the light on the front. Seriously though, is this thing on? When we first got it I ran a load so it would be running when my wife got home and I had to tell her that it was running and she didn't believe me. You would think silence would also mean not as powerful but it cleans really well and the ability to have it clean different quadrants came in very handy after Thanksgiving. I'm sure it would have done fine on normal but having the front targeted seemed to be the right choice. No more running down the stairs at night to turn it on because we forgot. I can just use the app to start it, luckily we are use to filling the detergent ahead of time as we like to tart it before going to bed. Being able to adjust settings has been helpful as well either thru the app or on the door itself. Overall, we are happy our old dishwasher stopped working should we could upgrade to this wonderful appliance!

Sentence (English): Beware the CrystalDry “Feature” and Bosch's Refusal to Stand Behind It.
Comments (English): Beware the CrystalDry “Feature” and Bosch's Refusal to Stand Behind It. I purchased this $1,400+ Bosch 800 Series dishwasher in 2022 specifically for its vaunted CrystalDry technology that promised “the ultimate dry – even on plastics.” Three years of light-to-moderate use later, the machine began throwing an E07 error code. The flat plastic spray arm water supply tube (part 00628334 / 11018097) had multiple cracks and a hole exactly where it is blasted by hot steam from the zeolite drying system. The plastic literally became brittle and shattered under the repeated heat cycles that Bosch itself engineered into the machine. This is not isolated bad luck; it is an extremely well-documented design flaw across the entire CrystalDry lineup. Bosch quietly fixed the problem in later production runs by adding a molded heat shield around the tube, yet they refuse to acknowledge the earlier versions were defective. I contacted Bosch Customer Care with photos and a polite explanation of the known issue. Their response? ” NO RESPONSE. No goodwill part, no discounted replacement. For a company that markets “German engineering” and “lifetime stainless tub” warranties, refusing to address an obvious material incompatibility between their own drying system and a critical $40 plastic tube is indefensible. The dishwasher now sits unusable while I shop for a new dishwasher, and I will never purchase anything Bosch going forward. Save yourself the headache: if you want CrystalDry-level drying without the self-destructing plumbing, look at Miele or even KitchenAid's comparable models. Bosch's premium price does not buy premium support when their design flaws surface. Extremely disappointed.

This has you either removing the top utensil rack or choosing to wash tall glassware by hand. Either way in the low position the adjustable rack is too close to the bottom to clear plates and silverware. Seems like a pretty big design flaw that you'd never really know until you put your dishes in it.

Sentence (English): Product less durable than my past whirlpool dishwasher - NEEDED REPAIRS FROM THE BEGINNING.
Comments (English): Product less durable than my past whirlpool dishwasher - NEEDED REPAIRS FROM THE BEGINNING. Delivered end of May, installed beginning of July. Not used until August. Not used frequently (small household). Does NOT dry well! Did NOT clean well. Called Whirlpool for service just before Thanksgiving. The pump was not working well from the get-go. Pump ordered and replaced in December. Heating element works and therefore was not replaced, but does NOT dry well, even on extended dry - dishes left dripping wet and need to towel dry. (Never had this issue with any of my last dishwashers). After pump replacement/repair, it seemed to clean better. Have only run it three times since the new pump, and now there is loud electric hum that did not exist before…back on the phone with Whirlpool. It's probably something new, but if it is the pump again, whirlpool has a problem with the parts being supplied to them. So much plastic on the new dishwashers…will this one last as long as my previous? The last one a whirlpool only lasted 13 years (and the soap dispenser was not longer working after 6yrs, and after 9 yrs it had to be manually reset every time we ran it, but it cleaned well and dried well. Note: many machines can no longer be manually reset and you must bring in a repair person…why? This detail makes me think I will not buy a whirlpool dishwasher in the future.). My mother's dishwasher is 20+ years old and still going strong. Is it really so difficult to make a strong and reliable product anymore? Also, this model does not have wheels on it (my last model had rear wheels), which I think should be standard to aid with moving the machine for multiple repairs, which it looks like a possibility for many of us. I rate this 2 stars, Fair, because it needed repairs right out of the box and after the repair, it does clean, and whirlpool did send someone to repair it. But this could easily become a poor/1 star, if we have to keep repairing it, or it becomes irreparable… And it could become a 3/Average, if it lasts 15 years without needing another repair. But because it doesn't really dry well, I don't think it could become a 4-5/Good-Excellent. A plus, the whirlpool repair person was great - kind and courteous. Since whirlpool contracts with local repair shops, I can't say how much whirlpool has to do with that, but I got lucky.

Sentence (English): Our previous dishwasher was definitely showing its age, so we decided to upgrade to the Top Control 24-Inch Stainless Steel LG Dishwasher with QuadWash (Model LDNPQ44HS).
Comments (English): [ Top Control 24 Inch Stainless Steel LG Dishwasher with QuadWash ] || ---------------- || Our previous dishwasher was definitely showing its age, so we decided to upgrade to the Top Control 24-Inch Stainless Steel LG Dishwasher with QuadWash (Model LDNPQ44HS). As satisfied owners of an LG refrigerator and TV, we trust the brand's quality. This is a truly modern machine, boasting WiFi connectivity via LG's ThinQ Technology. The standout feature is the ThinQ UP capability, which lets us download new wash cycles and upgrade existing ones. For instance, the downloadable "P7-Night Care" cycle washes dishes quietly overnight, a feature I'm very excited about! Beyond the smart tech, the cleaning power is impressive. The LG QuadWash® Pro uses multi-motion spray arms with powerful jets and microbubbles to ensure superior cleaning that reaches every corner, perfect for dirty dishes and pots. We also love the third rack, which is ideal for long utensils, knives, and pinch bowls. This dishwasher is packed with features, and I highly recommend reading the manual to maximize all its capabilities.
